messages.subject: Interaction in R (lavaan)
parts:
Hi Community, 
I could use some help with my R-Syntax.
Here is my model in lavaan:


model <- ' 
# latent variables definitions
dg =~ abc0301 + abc0302 + abc0303 +abc0304  
pg =~ abc0103 + abc0104 + abc0105  
pg2 =~ abc0101 + abc0102 + abc0106  
ig =~ abd0101 + abd0102 + abd0103  
infg =~ abc0210 + abc0211 + abc0212
zufr =~ aba0102 + aba0103 + aba0105  
# regressions
infg ~ zufr
zufr ~ dg + pg + pg2 + ig +infg
dg ~ pg + pg2

# modifications
infg ~~ ig
infg ~~ pg
infg ~~ pg2
ig ~~ pg
ig ~~ pg2
pg ~~ pg2
abc0103 ~~ abc0104
abc0302 ~~ abc0303
abc0301 ~~ abc0304
abc0101 ~~ abc0102 

#controllvariables
zufr   ~ alter + migrationshintergrund + hausarbeitenanteil + frauenanteil + sozialerstatus
'

Now I wanna check this model for an interaction between my latent variables dg, pg, pg2, ig, infg and the observed variable sex (geschlecht). in the regression path to the dependant variable zufr.
The Stata Syntax would look like: reg Zufr c.DG##c.Geschlecht c.PG##c.Geschlecht ................

How can I check my model for this interactions?

Thank you very much

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Interaction in R (lavaan)
parts:
Latent-variable interactions is not directly supported in lavaan.  If you look in the semTools package, there is a function called indProd() that is designed to help create orthogonalized product indicators for latent interaction factors.  The help page ?indProd also contains references so you can read about the method.

There is also a package nlsem that can estimate latent moderated structural equations (Iike Mplus, but runs slow and the syntax is not as user-friendly -- but not difficult if you are familiar with LISREL matrices).

Terry
